pairs: Their idols have been placed upon beasts and cattle,
onera vestra gravi pondere usque ad lassitudinem.
They were not able to save the one who carried them,
et anima eorum in captivitatem ibit.
and their life will go into captivity.
all the remnant of the house of Israel,
who are carried in my bosom,
who were born from my womb.
Even to your old age, I am the same.
et usque ad canos ego portabo;
And even with your grey hairs, I will carry you.
To whom would you liken me,
or consider me to be similar?
You take gold from a bag,
and you weigh silver on a scale,
so as to hire a goldsmith to make a god.
They carry him on their shoulders,
and they set him in his place.
ac de loco suo non movebitur:
And he will stand still and will not move from his place.
sed et cum clamaverint ad eum,
But even when they will cry out to him,
He will not save them from tribulation.
and there is no other god.
There is no one like me.
From the beginning, I announce the last things,
et ab initio quæ necdum facta sunt, dicens:
and from the start, the things that have not yet been done,
saying: My plan will stand firm,
and my entire will shall be done.
I call a bird from the east,
et de terra longinqua virum voluntatis meæ:
and from a far away land, the man of my will.
and I will carry it out.
I have created, and I will act.
you who are hard of heart,
I have brought my justice near.
It will not be far away,
and my salvation will not be delayed.
I will grant salvation in Zion,
